title: One common etale cover trivializes all signed finite Tate powers
statement: Let A be any commutative ring, m>0 with mA=0, and T a scheme on which m is a unit. Use the signed finite Tate sheaves A_T(a) [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf], constructed from the degree-one scalar extension [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist] and sheaf tensor and Hom [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pur-sheaf-hom]. There is a single etale cover U of T such that for every member U_i and every integer a, the restriction of A_T(a) to the slice site at U_i is isomorphic to the constant A-module sheaf A. No finiteness assumption on A is imposed.

proof.text: Pull back primitiveRootsCover along T.toSpecGamma. The source library proves this map etale and surjective. Its tautological primitive root has invertible differences of distinct powers, so isIso_constantZModToRootsOfUnitySheaf_of_isUnit_sub gives a cyclic basis. The normalized source roots comparison transports the pulled-back roots sheaf to that cyclic sheaf.

Construct sectionwise the scalar-extension isomorphism from A tensor over ZMod m with mu_m to A tensor over integers with the underlying abelian group. CompatibleSMul follows from integer representatives in ZMod m. Reconcile integer module structures by the identity additive equivalence and the counit of the integer-module/abelian-group equivalence. Naturality is checked on pure tensors using counit naturality and map_preimage. Sheafify this natural isomorphism. Compose inverse-image scalar-extension comparison, the roots comparison, the inverse cyclic-basis isomorphism and extendScalarsConstantZModIso to trivialize the coefficient line.

Recursively tensor the line basis for nonnegative powers. For negative powers, apply the source inverse-image internal-Hom comparison, transport the two arguments to the unit, and use the unit internal-Hom isomorphism. Transfer all these trivializations to the slice site through overSheafEquiv and its constant-sheaf comparison. This is one cover for every signed exponent.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleTwistCommonLocalBases (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hA : (m : A) = 0) :
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}), IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)) →
      ∃ U : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T, ∀ (i : U.I₀) (a : ℤ),
        Nonempty ((finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a).over (U.etalePrecoverageToEtale i) ≅
          (constantSheaf (T.smallEtaleTopology.over (U.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A)))
